name: Stealth Ox Alpha
description: Stealth Ox Alpha is a reasoning model available during a stealth release, with its developer currently undisclosed. It is designed for coding, sustained agentic work, complex reasoning and workflows combining text with visual context.

page_notice.markdown: Ox Alpha is a multimodal reasoning model from Z.AI for coding, sustained agentic work, and complex problem solving. It accepts text, image, and video inputs and supports tool calling, structured outputs, and a 1M-token context window. Ox Alpha is GLM 5.3 Flash. [View the GLM 5.3 Flash model page](/models/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash).

verification.notes: Model availability and capabilities are verified against Venice's live models API. The developer is currently undisclosed, so the model is grouped under Phaseo's generic Stealth organisation.
